_comment: #1780: a DynamoDB design summary (schema_designs.dynamodb) whose merge kept an authoritative home for two overlaps, the risk register's design-conflict risks, the facts.dynamodb_merge_reviews the facts layer computes from them, and the lines the engineering report and the results page print. tests/unit/report/test_merge_review_decisions.py checks the facts and the engineering report against it; DynamoDBMergeReviewsCallout.test.js checks the results page.

risks.description: [dynamodb] wp_posts modelled independently by design groups in WpPosts (group 1; PK=POST#{ID}), wp_posts (group 2; PK=post_name); the merge keeps WpPosts as the authoritative home (chosen by the statements its access patterns serve, then their design RPS) and wp_posts as a derived copy; review before migration.
risks.mitigation: Build the DynamoDB Streams consumer that keeps wp_posts in sync from WpPosts, the authoritative home, or move the access patterns on wp_posts onto a global secondary index of WpPosts.

risks.description: [dynamodb] wp_comments, wp_commentmeta modelled independently by design groups in Comments (group 1; PK=COMMENT#{comment_ID}), CommentsByPost (group 3; PK=POST#{comment_post_ID}), comment_meta (group 4; PK=meta_id); the merge keeps Comments as the authoritative home (chosen by the statements its access patterns serve, then their design RPS) and CommentsByPost, comment_meta as derived copies; review before migration.
risks.mitigation: Build the DynamoDB Streams consumer that keeps CommentsByPost and comment_meta in sync from Comments, the authoritative home, or move the access patterns on CommentsByPost and comment_meta onto a global secondary index of Comments.

title: DynamoDB merge-review decisions

decisions.line: wp_posts: the merge chose WpPosts as the authoritative home, which takes every write to it; wp_posts is a derived copy updated from the DynamoDB Streams of WpPosts (RISK-004).

wp_comments, wp_commentmeta: the merge chose Comments as the authoritative home, which takes every write to them; CommentsByPost, comment_meta are derived copies updated from the DynamoDB Streams of Comments (RISK-005).

facts.summary_line: The DynamoDB group merge found 3 source tables modelled independently by more than one design group. It chose 2 authoritative homes, which take every write to those source tables, and kept 3 tables as derived copies updated from DynamoDB Streams.
facts.review_line: The merge chose each home by the statements its access patterns serve, then their design RPS. Review each choice before migration: reads on a derived copy are eventually consistent and can return rows older than the latest write.
